objective: Test the elimination/fill-in warning directly: whether R/F/G/H deletions split residual connectivity and whether moves cause remote component changes after reduction.
motivation: Cross-domain elimination methods preserve induced interactions when removed structure mediates surviving variables. Current component monoid is a representation factorization, not yet an independence theorem.
scope: seven complete bounded Connect4 carriers used by the current rank-sufficiency campaign

outcomes.remote_effect: direct falsifier of context-free component dynamics at that stage
outcomes.no_remote_effect: bounded support for local dynamic factorization
